verdict.rationale: The docs show batching many typed questions into a single TypeSafe call. The parallel-questions cookbook claims this is 12.2x cheaper and 10.0x faster, the fan-out pattern sends many questions per call, and one guardrails request screens every message. An AsyncTypeSafeClient and published rate limits support high-volume concurrent requests. However, batching is per-request (many questions against one state), not a dedicated bulk job over many items. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint for processing many separate items/states in one job, explicit guidance on bulk throughput across large item sets, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk usage.
